text:
Samira Patel: Tried to kick off the 22:00 prod push and got an MFA failure from the deploy gateway. Who currently has prod-deploy role after the role-sync last night? :thinking:
Ben Keller: I saw the role-sync log. It removed 'contractors-prod' mapping and tightened group membership, might have dropped a few service accounts. :grimacing:
Samira Patel: Ugh. The deploy says: `403 MFA_REQUIRED` and points to group check. deploy-bot, can you dump the gate checks for my user?
deploy-bot: Automated check: user=samira.patel, groups=[eng, releases], roles=[developer]; required_roles=[prod-deployer, mfa-enabled]; result=DENY. See https://intra.redwood/ops/deploy-gate for details. :lock:
Alice Nguyen: Samira — did you register a device with our new KMS-backed MFA flow? We migrated to hardware+push last week.
Samira Patel: I have TOTP but not the new push device. I assumed TOTP would be fine.
Ben Keller: The change was intentional — production now requires push or U2F. We should've sent a blast, my bad.
Ivan Lewis: Short term options: 1) grant a one-off JIT elevation (audit ticket required) 2) let a currently eligible oncall do the deploy 3) rollback to last pinned canary if urgent.
Samira Patel: We need to ship the analytics fix before the morning snapshot. Can an oncall cover? Who's oncall tonight?
oncall-bot: Oncall: Ivan Lewis (primary) until 23:59 UTC. Pager rotation: ivan.lewis -> maya.ramirez tomorrow.
Ivan Lewis: I can take the JIT, but prefer a delegation so Samira can still run deploys in this window. Ben, can you open a JIT ticket? Put details and link to the release notes.
Ben Keller: Opening JIT-451 now. Description: temporary prod-deploy grant for samira.patel, expires 2026-03-09T23:59Z, reason=ship analytics hotfix, change-window=22:00-23:30 PST. Audit log will capture all deploy API calls. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/issue/JIT-451
Samira Patel: Thanks. Ben — once JIT is applied can you ping here? Also I'll pin the release version to avoid accidental auto-roll forward: `service/analytics:v2.3.1`
Ben Keller: JIT applied, confirmed via deploy-bot. deploy-bot: user=samira.patel, temporary_roles=[prod-deployer], expires=2026-03-09T23:59Z. :white_check_mark:
Samira Patel: Kicking off deploy now: `./deploy --service analytics --image service/analytics:v2.3.1 --canary 10% --rollout 15m`
Alice Nguyen: Watching logs. If we see >2% error spike, be ready to rollback to v2.3.0.
Samira Patel: Canary progressing, latency looks stable. :rocket:
Ivan Lewis: I'm on standby. If we need urgent rollback, use `deploy rollback --to service/analytics:v2.3.0` and notify infra@redwood.
Samira Patel: Completed. No regressions in the last 12 minutes. Marking release notes ready and closing JIT after audit collection. :tada:
Ben Keller: I'll expire the JIT in 10m and attach audit logs. Good catch on the MFA gap — we'll follow up with comms and a checklist so this doesn't surprise people next week.
Alice Nguyen: Suggestion for policy doc edit: add a fallback handoff process in case MFA migration affects deploy access. I'll open an RFC.
Samira Patel: Thanks all. Closing thread.
